title: Sparkly television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x='18' y='25' width='64' height='48' rx='8' ry='8' fill='#3a7bd5'/>
  <rect x='18' y='25' width='64' height='48' rx='8' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#5ba8ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x='26' y='32' width='48' height='32' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <rect x='26' y='32' width='48' height='32' rx='4' ry='4' fill='none' stroke='#3a3a7a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Screen glow lines -->
  <line x1='32' y1='40' x2='46' y2='40' stroke='#4a90ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='47' x2='40' y2='47' stroke='#4a90ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='54' x2='50' y2='54' stroke='#4a90ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Screen face -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#66ccff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#66ccff'/>
  <path d='M54 52 Q59 57 64 52' stroke='#66ccff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Antenna -->
  <line x1='40' y1='25' x2='36' y2='14' stroke='#5ba8ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='25' x2='64' y2='14' stroke='#5ba8ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='13' r='2.5' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='13' r='2.5' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  <!-- TV legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='73' width='5' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#2a5aa5'/>
  <rect x='63' y='73' width='5' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#2a5aa5'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 1 top-left -->
  <polygon points='12,10 14,16 20,18 14,20 12,26 10,20 4,18 10,16' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 2 top-right -->
  <polygon points='86,8 88,13 93,15 88,17 86,22 84,17 79,15 84,13' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 3 bottom-left -->
  <polygon points='10,80 12,85 17,87 12,89 10,94 8,89 3,87 8,85' fill='#ffb3e6'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 4 bottom-right -->
  <polygon points='90,78 92,83 97,85 92,87 90,92 88,87 83,85 88,83' fill='#ffb3e6'/>
  <!-- Small dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='18' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='22' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='62' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='60' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='88' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='90' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
